To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
exploratory search systems should be designed with the future in mind.
the design of exploratory search interfaces requires the integration of retrieval histories and ambient displays to support the analysis and evaluation of search results.

1) users need a way to keep track of their search history, 2) the system should provide users with a way to easily find information they have previously seen, 3) users want the system to help them remember the information they have found, and 4) users want the interface to help them find information they have forgotten.
In summary, our research is concerned with
designing for the future by learning from the past.
designing for exploratory information retrieval tasks, and the design of novel search interfaces and systems that support these activities.
designing for exploratory searching, which we believe to be the future of information retrieval.

exploratory search activities can be supported by a combination of novel visualizations, ambient displays, and persuasive elements.
